descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Step into the ring with Golden Gloves VR, the official game of Golden Gloves of America and the official esports platform of USA Boxing.
Train like a fighter in immersive gyms with realistic equipment, sharpen your technique, and get one of the most effective full-body workouts in VR. Work the heavy bag, speed bag, double-end bag, and uppercut bag. Each one uses physics built to match the real thing for an authentic boxing experience in virtual reality.
Take on our viral Mitts Challenge: test your speed, timing, and accuracy, chase high scores, and challenge your friends. Then face AI opponents or step into real-time multiplayer sparring against players worldwide.
Want more than a workout? Enter our cloud-based official tournaments, climb the rankings, earn prizes, and compete for a path that leads all the way to the USA Boxing National Championships.
Whether you're a boxing fan, fitness enthusiast, gamer, or aspiring champion, this is your way to play, train, and compete.
Play. Train. Compete.
